units.source_text: 火车从北面爬上县界的山，穿过长长的隧道，

en.t: The train climbed the mountain at the prefectural border from the north and passed through a long tunnel,

units.source_text: 只见冬日下午淡淡的阳光像被地底下的黑暗所吞噬，

en.t: the pale light of a winter afternoon seemed to be swallowed by the darkness underground,

units.source_text: 又像那陈旧的火车把明亮的外壳脱落在隧道里，

en.t: as though the old train had shed its bright outer shell inside the tunnel,

units.source_text: 在重重叠叠的山峦之间，向暮色苍茫的峡谷驶去。

en.t: it moved on between layer upon layer of mountains toward a gorge dim with dusk.

units.source_text: 山的这一侧还没有下雪。

en.t: On this side of the mountains, snow had not yet fallen.
